_about: In-world tasks. Real-life ones are never here — each app writes its own to ~/.linggen/quests/<app>.json. A hosted game costs rewards.json stamina.cost.game when it is paid (论道 when it opens) and pays from the `game` table: a little, every day — the card fight is where 修为 is earned.

tasks._beats: The opening's playable beats (Hanli 2026-10-14: 「每看一会儿剧情就要有游戏可以玩」): each plays the book's own action where its scene stands. A board ends in a win always; its `grade` (the game's) picks the mark from `marks` (tasks.mjs win) and, where the scene's exits say `needs.grade`, which of them the win takes.
